meaning: "I take refuge in Amida Buddha." The nembutsu of Pure Land Buddhism: the name of the Buddha of Infinite Light, said in trust.
purpose: To rest in trust rather than effort.
when: Any time; often repeated many times on a mala.
note: Central to Jōdo-shū and Jōdo Shinshū in Japan; the same practice is chanted as Namo Amituofo in Chinese Buddhism.
source: Pure Land Buddhist practice (Jōdo-shū, Jōdo Shinshū)
name: Namu Amida Butsu
